name: @aiti-ai/aiti-service-tunnels

description: One-click public reachability for local services — port discovery (service identification/custom names) / five exposure modes (tunnel·vhost·hybrid·router portmap·IPv6 direct) / auth gateway (portal·TOTP·face and voiceprint) / DDNS auto resolution / network health doctor

descriptionI18n.zh-CN: 本机服务一键公网可达 —— 端口发现（服务识别/自定义名）/ 五种暴露模式（隧道·vhost·混合·路由器映射·IPv6 直连）/ 认证网关（portal·TOTP·人脸声纹）/ DDNS 自动解析 / 网络体检 doctor

soul: 本地服务不该被防火墙关起来——在哪都应该可以安全访问。

soulI18n.en: Local services should not be locked behind a firewall — they should be safely reachable from anywhere.
